Show a narrow visible strip of that terrace at the bottom of the composition, with a physically legible edge and exposed side/retaining face where the access stair begins. Add ONE reasonably human-scaled stair flight at the FOREGROUND-LEFT SIDE of this landing, descending away from the camera onto a clear patch of the main floor, OUTSIDE the front portal security bay. Protect the exposed SIDES of the desk terrace and the stair opening with thin graphite posts, restrained brass handrails and clear glass infill matching the station. Rails connect into the stair handrails and level landing edge. Keep these foreground railings LOW IN FRAME, with modest real-world proportions and a clear horizontal level top where appropriate. The center foreground is RESERVED for the separately rendered desk and interaction view: DO NOT run a solid rail, post or glass gate across the center desk zone, DO NOT bisect the front portal silhouette. No wall-length obstruction across the left city-pan view, no giant railing or massive foreground staircase. Preserve safe-looking generous walking clearance around all portal bays and along the right-hand department doors.

1970s ANIME FINISH, RESTRAININED AND CLEAN:
Use the visual language of classic 1970s hand-painted Japanese science-fiction animation backgrounds: economical precise dark-brown/charcoal drawn contours; broader simplified gouache color shapes; slightly warm paper/stone whites; dusty but varied mineral color pigments; reduced glossy gradient modeling; modest flat local value planes; faint painted surface texture only at selected material transitions. Slightly warmer ochre/brass and rust, burgundy textiles, charcoal hardware, pale neutral stone. Preserve distinct material colors. This is a clean newly painted animation background, NOT a worn film scan. NO blur, VHS effects, chromatic aberration, scanlines, heavy grain, sepia blanket, oversaturated orange, pastel wash, comic-book halftone or dramatic retro color grade. The finish must remain legible and crisp enough for a close gameplay camera.
